dual_momentum.name: Active Dual Momentum GTAA
dual_momentum.plain_english_description: Rebalance monthly. Risky assets: SPY, QQQ, IWM, EFA, EEM, GLD, TLT, VNQ. Apply absolute trend gate: Close > 200d SMA and 126d ROC > 0. Rank passing assets by 63d and 126d momentum, select top 3 assets, and allocate using 60d inverse volatility risk parity weighting. Assign unallocated capital to cash proxy BIL.

baa_keller.name: Bold Asset Allocation (BAA-G12)
baa_keller.plain_english_description: Rebalance monthly. Use every asset in the universe as a canary indicator. If any canary asset has Close below 200d SMA or 126d ROC <= 0, market is turbulent. In calm markets, select top 3 offensive assets from the universe by 126d ROC with equal weighting. In turbulent markets, select top 3 defensive assets from the universe with positive 126d ROC. Assign remainder to cash proxy BIL.

volatility_managed.name: Volatility-Managed Portfolio
volatility_managed.plain_english_description: Rebalance monthly. Risky assets: SPY, QQQ, IWM, EFA, EEM, GLD, TLT, VNQ. Dynamically scale portfolio risk exposure using 20-day volatility-managed inverse variance scaling targeting 15% annual volatility, de-leveraging into cash proxy BIL when volatility spikes.

accelerating_dual_momentum.name: Accelerating Dual Momentum (ADM)
accelerating_dual_momentum.description: Chris Ludlow & Steve Hanly (2018) 4-ETF dual momentum strategy on SPY/SCZ equity sleeves with TLT/TIP bond fallback.

vigilant_asset_allocation.name: Vigilant Asset Allocation (VAA-G4)
vigilant_asset_allocation.description: Keller & Keuning (2017) 13612W momentum formula binary switching strategy between offensive and defensive universes. Requires --vaa-offensive-universe/--vaa-defensive-universe on the command line (no hardcoded default universe).

rsi_mean_reversion.name: RSI(2) Mean-Reversion
rsi_mean_reversion.description: Connors-style RSI(2) long-only mean-reversion timing strategy extended for multi-asset evaluation.

swing_trend_pullback.name: Trend-Pullback Swing
swing_trend_pullback.description: Trend-following pullback swing strategy buying dips in confirmed uptrends across active risky symbols.

chan_pivot_shift.name: Chan Pivot Shift
chan_pivot_shift.description: Original, from-scratch reading of Chan theory (缠中说缠): buys once the price pivot (consolidation range) steps up to a wholly higher band and a confirming pullback low forms; not a port of the third-party czsc library.

chan_three_type.name: Chan Three-Type Buy/Sell Points
chan_three_type.description: Additive extension of chan_pivot_shift: segments (线段), segment-level pivots, real MACD-histogram-area divergence (背驰), and the formal 一/二/三类买卖点 taxonomy; coexists with chan_pivot_shift, does not replace it.

chan_pivot_shift_macd.name: Chan Pivot Shift (MACD)
chan_pivot_shift_macd.description: Additive copy of chan_pivot_shift: same stroke-based pivot-band-shift buy/sell rule, but its disclosed stroke-slope divergence proxy replaced by real MACD-histogram-area divergence (背驰), made symmetric (top-divergence sell AND bottom-divergence buy); coexists with chan_pivot_shift, does not replace it.

chan_pivot_shift_macd_adv.name: Chan Pivot Shift (MACD) Advanced
chan_pivot_shift_macd_adv.description: Enhanced sibling of chan_pivot_shift_macd (which is left unmodified): adds a MACD zero-axis entry gate (Lesson 103), weekly-level 区间套 re-confirmation, a dangerous pivot-relation exit brake (Lessons 92-99), a 盘整背驰-vs-背驰 divergence-strength filter, an opt-in volume confirmation, and coincidence-based position sizing (Lesson 061).

chan_mtf_trend.name: Chan Multi-Timeframe Trend
chan_mtf_trend.description: Interval-nesting (区间套) strategy combining a macro 200-day SMA trend gate with sub-period Chan structural buy signals (B1/B2/B3).

chan_trend_third_buy.name: Chan Trend Third Buy
chan_trend_third_buy.description: Focused high-momentum trend continuation trading 3rd-type buy points (B3 - pivot breakout retest holding above pivot upper band ZG).

chan_mean_reversion_divergence.name: Chan Mean-Reversion Divergence
chan_mean_reversion_divergence.description: Bottom-fishing on 1st-type buy points (B1 from MACD divergence) coupled with Lesson 103 '防狼术' tight risk controls (tight stop-loss, profit target, trailing stop, max holding cap).

chan_composite.name: Chan Composite Multi-Stage Scaling
chan_composite.description: Dynamic multi-stage position scaling across all 3 Chan buy point types (30% on B1 bottom divergence, +40% on B2 higher-low pullback, +30% on B3 pivot breakout retest).

chan_best_selector.name: Chan Best Selector Compound Meta-Strategy
chan_best_selector.description: Compound meta-strategy evaluating 7 Chan strategies in parallel, tracking rolling Sharpe/return performance over a 63-day lookback window, and dynamically allocating 100% of portfolio capital to the top-performing Chan strategy.

chan_pivot_oscillation.name: Chan Pivot-Oscillation Monitor
chan_pivot_oscillation.description: Lesson 92's Pivot-Oscillation Monitor (中枢震荡监视器): tracks each pivot sub-swing's midpoint (Zn) drift relative to the pivot's own center (Z) to trade a strengthening bias, avoiding wedge bull-/bear-trap breakouts and Lessons 92-99's dangerous pivot-relation state.

chan_fibo_sector_strength.name: Chan Fibonacci MA Sector-Strength Rotation
chan_fibo_sector_strength.description: Lesson 106's Fibonacci MA sector-strength system (斐波那契均线系统): ranks every risky symbol by how many Fibonacci-period SMAs (5/13/21/34/55/89/144/233) it trades above (tier 0-8), and rotates equal weight across the top-tier symbols.

chan_failed_retest_buy.name: Chan Failed-Retest Buy
chan_failed_retest_buy.description: Lesson 108's precise bottom definition + '下探失败买' rule: only confirms a B1 entry once a second dip fails to make a new low relative to the first bottom fractal (a failed retest of the low), rather than entering on the raw divergence bottom itself.

compounder_margin_of_safety.name: Compounder Margin of Safety
compounder_margin_of_safety.description: Price-only proxy adaptation of a conservative value-investing community's valuation framework (see docs/snowball_strategy.txt): holds a candidate blue-chip only while in a confirmed uptrend with contained volatility (a proxy for the doc's moat/high-ROE quality screen) and its own trailing annualized return clears a required hurdle; exits once that trailing return decays below the benchmark's own trailing return. DISCLOSED SIMPLIFICATION: no real fundamentals (ROE/dividend/earnings growth) are used -- see the separate fundamental_screener project for a real-data version.

adaptive_grid.name: ATR-Adaptive Grid
adaptive_grid.description: Volatility-scaled grid trading strategy with trend filters and equity drawdown circuit breakers.

ensemble_regime_switching.name: Regime-Switching Ensemble
ensemble_regime_switching.description: ADX regime-switching ensemble combining trend-following and RSI mean-reversion sleeves.

turtle_breakout_s1.name: Turtle Channel Breakout (System 1 - 20d)
turtle_breakout_s1.description: Classic Turtle System 1 20-day Donchian channel breakout with 10-day exit, 2N ATR trailing stop, 200d SMA trend filter, and inverse ATR risk weighting.

turtle_breakout_s2.name: Turtle Channel Breakout (System 2 - 55d)
turtle_breakout_s2.description: Classic Turtle System 2 55-day Donchian channel breakout with 20-day exit, 2N ATR trailing stop, 200d SMA trend filter, and inverse ATR risk weighting.

permanent_portfolio.name: Permanent Portfolio (Harry Browne)
permanent_portfolio.description: Static 25% SPY / 25% TLT / 25% BIL / 25% GLD allocation, annual rebalance. SPY substitutes for the canonical VTI.

golden_butterfly.name: Golden Butterfly (Portfolio Charts)
golden_butterfly.description: Static 20% each SPY / IWM / TLT / BIL / GLD allocation, annual rebalance. IWM and BIL are disclosed substitutes for small-cap-value (VBR) and short-term treasuries (SHY).

all_weather.name: All Weather / All Seasons (Dalio-style retail approximation)
all_weather.description: Static 30% SPY / 40% TLT / 15% IEF / 7.5% GLD / 7.5% DBC allocation, annual rebalance. A fixed-weight approximation, not genuine risk-budgeted risk parity.

hfea.name: HFEA (Hedgefundie's Excellent Adventure)
hfea.description: Static 55% UPRO / 45% TMF leveraged risk-parity allocation, quarterly rebalance. Synthetic data does NOT model genuine 3x leverage/volatility decay -- see class docstring.

protective_asset_allocation.name: Protective Asset Allocation (PAA)
protective_asset_allocation.description: Keller & Keuning (2016) breadth-based continuous crash-protection allocation across an 11-asset universe plus an IEF protection sleeve.

adaptive_asset_allocation.name: Adaptive Asset Allocation (AAA)
adaptive_asset_allocation.description: Butler/Philbrick/Gordillo/Varadi (2012) momentum-filter + minimum-variance optimization across an 8-asset universe.
